'''''Probability Surveys''''' is an open-access electronic journal that is jointly sponsored by the [[Bernoulli Society]] and the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]]. It publishes review articles on topics of interest in [[probability theory]].

==Managing Editors==
*[[David Aldous]] (2004&ndash;2008)
*[[Geoffrey Grimmett]] (2009&ndash;2011)
*[[Laurent Saloff-Coste]] (2012&ndash;2014)
*[[Ben Hambly]] (2015&ndash;2020)
*{{ill|Mikhail A. Lifshits|de|Michail Anatoljewitsch Lifschitz}} (2021&ndash;2023)
*Adam Jakubowski (2024&ndash;2026)
